login.title: Sign in to Mercurio
login.description: Use the email and password of your account.
login.activateHint: Did you receive an activation code?

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.description: Enter the 6-digit code shown by your authenticator app.
mfa.recoveryHint: Each recovery code can be used only once.

activate.title: Activate your account
activate.description: Choose a password and set up the authenticator app.
activate.codeHint: Created by the administrator. It works only once.
activate.passwordHint: 12 to 128 characters. A long phrase beats a complicated word.
activate.signIn: Already have an account? Sign in

enroll.title: Set up the authenticator app
enroll.description: Scan the QR code with an app such as Aegis, 2FAS or Google Authenticator, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
enroll.qrLabel: QR code for the authenticator app
enroll.manual: Cannot scan it? Enter this key by hand:

recovery.title: Save your recovery codes
recovery.description: If you lose access to the app, each of these codes lets you sign in once. They will not be shown again.
recovery.confirm: I saved the codes in a safe place

tenant.title: Choose the customer
tenant.description: Your account can access several customers. You can switch at any time.
